description: Store a concierge order after the buyer has accepted the current terms, then return the payment link for that order. Requires the acceptance token from accept_concierge_agreement. Rush service is refused when rush checkout is not configured, and the standard payment link is never used for a rush order. Do not send a Social Security number, date of birth, or a license number.

accept_agreement.description: True only if the buyer accepts the current terms.

email.description: Buyer email. The copy of the terms is sent here.

move_date.description: Move date, YYYY-MM-DD, from yesterday through one year ahead.

rush.description: True to add rush service. Refused when rush checkout is not configured.

service_location.description: New Texas address or ZIP, including a 5-digit Texas ZIP.

name: order_concierge
